fichas.title: Flat roofs and roof greening
fichas.summary: The page describes intensive and extensive roof planting, mobile greening, watering and feeding methods, green-roof layer structures, and plant species for extensive roofs. It states slope guidance and compares six green-roof profiles by growth height, build-up, loading, water supply, and layer thickness.
